rules.title: Assembly Bill 12 (California security deposit limits)
rules.requirement: Landlords may generally charge a security deposit of no more than one month's rent for furnished or unfurnished units. Deposits must be returned within 21 days of move-out with an itemized statement, and landlords must photograph the unit before and after the tenancy and offer a walk-through inspection.
rules.key_value: One month's rent maximum (two months for small landlords)

exempt_if.text: landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total

exempt_if.name: owner_type
exempt_if.text: ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or limited liability company (LLC) where all members are natural persons

coverage.summary: Applies to residential landlords' security deposits in California.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Small landlords with two properties and no more than four units total, owned by natural persons, family trusts or all-natural-person LLCs, may charge up to two months' rent.

rules.quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units

rules.title: Berkeley Rent Ordinance security deposit interest
rules.requirement: Landlords of units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance must pay tenants interest on security deposits at the end of each year, and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before year end.

requires.name: rent_ordinance_coverage
requires.text: units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance

coverage.summary: Applies to tenancies in units fully or partially covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.

rules.quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
